description: This file implements an API client wrapper around the fetch function, providing simplified methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with JSON handling, error handling, and URL joining logic. It utilizes a configuration module to get the API base URL and exposes functions for external modules to perform API calls.

methods.name: apiGet(path, opts = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the API with the specified path and options.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body, opts = {})
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body to the specified path.

methods.name: apiPut(path, body, opts = {})
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON body to the specified path.

methods.name: apiDelete(path, opts = {})
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified path.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Constructs a complete URL by joining the base URL with a relative path, handling trailing slashes appropriately.

methods.name: request(method, path, body, opts)
methods.description: Internal function that executes an HTTP request using fetch, handling headers, serialization, response parsing, and error normalization.
